About our brand and products:
KnitPal is a family-owned yarn and craft brand offering baby-soft yarns, knitting and crochet products, and beginner-friendly crafting resources. We love helping beginners, returning crafters, and experienced makers enjoy their next project.

What makes us different:
We focus on baby-soft, easy-to-work-with yarns, beautiful color choices, beginner-friendly products, and responsive customer service. We want both our customers and creator partners to have a positive experience with KnitPal.

How affiliates can earn:
Earn 10% commission on qualifying orders through your affiliate link or assigned creator coupon code.

How to promote us:
We welcome authentic, organic content including knitting and crochet tutorials, project videos, yarn reviews, project inspiration, blog content, and social media posts. Evergreen content is especially welcome.

Other information:
Paid advertising using the KnitPal brand is not permitted. We welcome creators who genuinely enjoy knitting, crochet, yarn, and helping others discover the joy of crafting.

KnitPal Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the KnitPal Affiliate Program! We’re excited to work with creators who share our love of knitting, crochet, yarn, and the crafting community.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals participating in the KnitPal Affiliate Program (“Affiliate,” “you,” or “your”). By joining and participating in the Program, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

KnitPal reserves the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program application at our sole discretion.

Participation in the Program is a privilege and does not create an employment, partnership, agency, or joint venture relationship between KnitPal and the Affiliate.

2. Affiliate Links, Coupons & Promotion

Each Affiliate will receive a unique affiliate link and may also receive a unique creator coupon code. Affiliates may generate affiliate links to specific KnitPal products or collections when this feature is available.

If a customer clicks more than one Affiliate's referral link, the most recent qualifying affiliate link will receive attribution, subject to the Program's tracking rules.

Creator Coupon Attribution

When a customer uses an Affiliate's assigned creator coupon code on an eligible purchase, the Affiliate will receive commission on that purchase even if the customer did not click the Affiliate's referral link or the Affiliate's tracking cookie has expired.

If a customer both clicks an Affiliate's link and uses that same Affiliate's coupon code, only one commission will be earned on the order.

Affiliates may promote only coupon codes assigned or specifically authorized by KnitPal. Affiliates may not publish, distribute, or promote KnitPal coupons or promotional codes that have not been assigned or approved for their use.

Organic Creator Promotion

The KnitPal Affiliate Program is intended primarily for organic creator promotion. Affiliates are encouraged to share KnitPal through their own content, including websites, blogs, YouTube, social media, tutorials, patterns, project content, email audiences, and other appropriate creator channels.

Paid advertising of KnitPal is not permitted without prior written approval from KnitPal. This includes paid search, Google Ads, Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads, sponsored placements purchased by the Affiliate, or other paid advertising using KnitPal's name, trademarks, products, affiliate links, or coupon codes.

Affiliates may not bid on “KnitPal,” variations or misspellings of the KnitPal name, or other KnitPal-branded search terms.

Affiliate links and creator coupons may not be posted on coupon, deal, cashback, or similar promotional websites without prior written approval from KnitPal.

Affiliates may not create websites, domains, social media accounts, usernames, or other properties that impersonate KnitPal or could reasonably be mistaken for an official KnitPal account.

3. Commissions & Payment

Affiliates earn commission on eligible purchases attributed to them according to the commission structure shown in their Affiliate Dashboard or Affiliate Guide.

Commission is calculated based on the eligible product value actually paid by the customer after discounts, excluding shipping charges, taxes, gift cards, and other non-product charges.

Commissions are earned only on successfully completed and qualifying transactions.

KnitPal reserves the right to review referral orders before approving commissions. Orders that are canceled, refunded, partially refunded, charged back, fraudulent, or otherwise invalid may have the related commission canceled or adjusted accordingly.

Commission Validation & Payment

Commissions are subject to a 30-day validation period before becoming eligible for payment. This allows time for cancellations, returns, refunds, chargebacks, and other order adjustments to be processed.

Approved commissions will be paid according to the payment schedule stated in the Affiliate Dashboard or Affiliate Guide.

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate and complete payment information through their Affiliate account.

Commission status can be viewed in the Commission section of the Affiliate Dashboard, and completed payments will be shown in the Payment section.

4. Marketing Tools & Brand Materials

KnitPal may provide Affiliates with promotional materials such as product images, banners, logos, graphics, collection materials, or other approved creative assets through the Program's Marketing Tools or directly from KnitPal.

Affiliates may use these materials to promote KnitPal through approved channels.

KnitPal's name, trademarks, logos, product images, and other brand assets remain the property of KnitPal. Participation in the Affiliate Program provides a limited right to use approved materials for the purpose of promoting KnitPal and does not transfer ownership of any KnitPal intellectual property.

Affiliates may not materially alter KnitPal branding in a misleading manner or represent themselves as KnitPal, an employee of KnitPal, or an official KnitPal account.

5. Cookie & Referral Tracking

KnitPal uses affiliate links, cookies, coupon codes, and other available tracking methods to attribute qualifying purchases to Affiliates.

The KnitPal Affiliate Program uses a 60-day cookie period.

When a customer clicks an Affiliate's referral link, the Affiliate may receive commission on an eligible purchase made by that customer within 60 days of the qualifying click, subject to the Program's attribution rules.

The 60-day period begins when the customer clicks the Affiliate's link — not when the Affiliate originally publishes the content containing the link. This means evergreen content may continue generating qualifying referrals for as long as the Affiliate's link remains active.

If a customer later clicks another Affiliate's qualifying referral link before purchasing, attribution may be assigned to the most recent qualifying Affiliate.

Cookies and similar tracking technologies depend on the customer's browser and privacy settings. If a customer blocks, deletes, or otherwise prevents tracking cookies, KnitPal may not be able to attribute the purchase through the Affiliate's link.

However, an Affiliate's valid creator-specific coupon code can still provide attribution as described in Section 2.

The 60-day cookie is intended to provide a reasonable purchase consideration period. It does not give an Affiliate automatic commission on every future purchase made by a customer they previously referred.

A subsequent purchase qualifies for commission when it is otherwise attributable to the Affiliate under the Program's current tracking rules, including through a qualifying affiliate link or use of the Affiliate's valid creator coupon.

6. Self-Referrals, Fraud & Prohibited Activity

Affiliates may not use their own affiliate links or creator coupon codes to earn commissions on their own purchases.

Affiliates may not artificially generate referrals, purchases, clicks, or commissions or otherwise manipulate the Affiliate Program.

Prohibited activity includes fraudulent transactions, misleading promotions, unauthorized coupon distribution, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, spam, impersonation of KnitPal, or other practices intended primarily to generate commissions without legitimate customer referrals.

KnitPal reserves the right to review suspicious transactions and withhold or cancel commissions associated with fraudulent, abusive, or prohibited activity.

7. Affiliate Disclosures & Marketing Practices

Affiliates are responsible for clearly disclosing their affiliate relationship with KnitPal when required.

Affiliate promotions should clearly and conspicuously disclose when the Affiliate may earn a commission from purchases made through their links or coupon codes, consistent with applicable FTC endorsement and advertising requirements.

Affiliates must represent KnitPal products accurately and may not make false, misleading, deceptive, or unsupported claims about KnitPal or its products.

Affiliates are responsible for complying with applicable laws, regulations, platform rules, email marketing requirements, and advertising disclosure requirements when promoting KnitPal.

8. Removal or Termination from the Affiliate Program

Affiliates may request removal from the KnitPal Affiliate Program at any time by contacting hello@knitpal.com.

KnitPal reserves the right to suspend or terminate an Affiliate's participation in the Program if the Affiliate violates these Terms and Conditions, engages in fraudulent or abusive activity, harms or misrepresents the KnitPal brand, or otherwise uses the Program in a manner inconsistent with its intended purpose.

Commissions associated with fraudulent transactions, prohibited activity, or material violations of these Terms may be canceled.

Valid commissions earned before termination will remain subject to the Program's normal validation, refund, and payment rules.

9. Changes to the Affiliate Program

KnitPal may update the Affiliate Program from time to time, including commission rates, coupon offers, cookie duration, payment schedules, promotional rules, or these Terms and Conditions.

Material changes will apply prospectively after they are communicated or published through the Affiliate Program, Affiliate Dashboard, Affiliate Guide, email, or other reasonable means.

Continued participation in the Program after an update takes effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Program terms.

10. Questions & Support

We want the KnitPal Affiliate Program to be a positive partnership for both KnitPal and our creators.

If you have questions about your affiliate links, coupon attribution, commissions, payments, promotional materials, or these Terms and Conditions, please contact us at hello@knitpal.com.

Thank you for being part of the KnitPal creator community. We look forward to seeing what you create and sharing the joy of yarn and crafting together.
